    Wolters Kluwer partners with Hitachi Cyber to deliver integrated governance, risk and compliance solutions

    Relationship combines TeamMate Risk & Compliance software with Hitachi Cyber's governance, risk, compliance, and privacy services to help organizations strengthen resilience, improve visibility, and reduce operational burden

    New York — Wolters Kluwer today announced a collaboration with Hitachi Cyber to help organizations strengthen governance, risk, compliance, privacy and cybersecurity programs through an integrated combination of technology, advisory expertise and ongoing program support. By bringing together TeamMate Risk & Compliance software and Hitachi Cyber's governance, risk, compliance and privacy capabilities, the collaboration helps organizations move beyond fragmented manual processes, gain greater visibility into risk and compliance activities, and build more mature, audit-ready programs.

    Under the relationship, Hitachi Cyber will resell TeamMate Risk & Compliance software and provide professional, managed GRC and privacy services to help organizations strengthen and mature their programs.

    TeamMate Risk & Compliance helps information security, compliance and risk teams manage cyber, operational, third-party and regulatory risk through a single connected platform. The collaboration combines TeamMate Risk & Compliance technology with Hitachi Cyber's managed cybersecurity, GRC and privacy services to help organizations strengthen programs, improve visibility and reduce manual effort.

    “Managing cybersecurity, third-party risk, and compliance obligations requires a more connected approach,” said Maria Montenegro, CEO, Wolters Kluwer Corporate Performance & ESG. “Together with Hitachi Cyber, we help customers build more structured and defensible programs, and we're already seeing results, including a global healthcare technology company as our first joint customer.”

    Helping information security, compliance and risk teams work with greater confidence

    Through this relationship, customers can access software together with professional and managed services that help them design, operate and improve governance, risk, compliance and privacy programs. Engagements may begin with advisory services and maturity assessments before transitioning to implementation support and ongoing managed services.

    “Organizations are facing increasing pressure to manage cyber risk, compliance obligations and privacy requirements while navigating growing regulatory complexity and resource constraints,” said Matt Castonguay, Chief Revenue Officer, Hitachi Cyber. “Through our collaboration with Wolters Kluwer, we're helping customers move beyond fragmented spreadsheets and disconnected processes by combining TeamMate's powerful platform with Hitachi Cyber's governance, risk, compliance and privacy expertise. Together, we provide the strategic guidance, operational support and continuous oversight organizations need to reduce compliance burden, strengthen resilience and give executive leadership greater confidence in their risk and audit readiness.”

    The collaboration supports organizations in highly regulated industries, including financial services, healthcare, government, critical infrastructure, energy and technology.

    Solutions for Health Plans

    As patient information and data continues to expand and the expectations to provide value-based care increase, health plan company leaders can equip their teams to understand the full patient and engage them to improve outcomes.

    Explore Solutions
    Explore Solutions

    Empower health plan leaders to enhance member engagement and optimize outcomes

    Health plan executives are navigating a healthcare landscape marked by increasing complexity and rapid change. Achieving a holistic understanding of members is essential for delivering quality care, educating members, assessing risk, maximizing reimbursements, and meeting value-based care objectives.

    However, challenges such as fragmented data systems and unstructured clinical information hinder comprehensive patient insights and accurate risk assessments. Additionally, evolving standards, regulations, and codes create operational hurdles that impact financial performance and population health management.

    To address these challenges, leveraging integrated, evidence-based solutions is critical. These tools not only reduce administrative burdens but also enhance member engagement and improve health outcomes. Personalized, accessible information empowers members to make informed decisions about their health, fostering trust and collaboration.

    Strategic solutions for modern health plans

    Health plan leaders can drive meaningful change by adopting advanced technologies and strategies, including:

    • Data governance and clinical NLP: Centralize and analyze healthcare data to uncover actionable insights and improve decision-making.
    • Evidence-based clinical content: Equip teams with trusted resources like UpToDate® to support accurate care decisions and enhance outcomes.
    • Member engagement tools: Solutions like UpToDate® Guide provide personalized, evidence-based care management to build trust and improve member satisfaction.
    • Digital health integration: Platforms such as UpToDate® Digital Architect accelerate innovation by embedding reliable health content into existing systems.
    • Drug data and decision support: Tools like Medi-Span® streamline drug pricing, formulary development, and medication decision-making.

    By integrating these solutions, health plan executives can optimize costs, meet modern care requirements, and improve health outcomes. Explore how Wolters Kluwer’s suite of evidence-based tools can empower your organization to navigate today’s challenges and achieve sustainable success.

Explore Solutions Explore Solutions Empower health plan leaders to enhance member engagement and optimize outcomes Health plan executives are navigating a healthcare landscape marked by increasing complexity and rapid change. Achieving a holistic understanding of members is essential for delivering quality care, educating members, assessing risk, maximizing reimbursements, and meeting value-based care objectives. However, challenges such as fragmented data systems and unstructured clinical information hinder comprehensive patient insights and accurate risk assessments. Additionally, evolving standards, regulations, and codes create operational hurdles that impact financial performance and population health management. To address these challenges, leveraging integrated, evidence-based solutions is critical. These tools not only reduce administrative burdens but also enhance member engagement and improve health outcomes. Personalized, accessible information empowers members to make informed decisions about their health, fostering trust and collaboration. Evidence-based clinical content: Equip teams with trusted resources like UpToDate®  to support accurate care decisions and enhance outcomes. Member engagement tools: Solutions like UpToDate® Guide  provide personalized, evidence-based care management to build trust and improve member satisfaction. Digital health integration: Platforms such as UpToDate® Digital Architect  accelerate innovation by embedding reliable health content into existing systems. Drug data and decision support: Tools like Medi-Span®  streamline drug pricing, formulary development, and medication decision-making. By integrating these solutions, health plan executives can optimize costs, meet modern care requirements, and improve health outcomes.
